contracts.protection_obligation: Investigator-agent evidence reads must be confined to the active ScopeContext: every investigator tool invocation must enforce scope at the tool/SQL layer so that chunk, entity, relationship, co-occurrence, timeline, and document reads falling outside the in-scope document set are refused (ScopeViolation surfaced to the model as ModelRetry), with the commit point at the scoped SQL execution / in-scope gate before rows are returned (e.g., fetch_chunk's _ensure_doc_in_scope gate before returning chunk text).
scope_limits: Guard covers only the nine tools registered on the PydanticAI agent in register_investigator_tools (investigator.py 258-352); supplied source shows no other agent-bound tools.
In fetch_chunk the chunk SELECT itself is unscoped (tools.py 560-568); enforcement is the post-query gate before return, so refusal happens at return time, not at query time.
fetch_chunk returns None for a nonexistent chunk_id without any scope check (tools.py 569-570).
_scope_doc_id_filter emits an unrestricted '1=1' fragment when scope.mode is neither DOCUMENT nor CASE (tools.py 61); which additional scope modes exist is not defined in supplied source.
The guard restricts reads/returns only; it protects no database mutation and no external effect.
Refusal is delivered to the model as a retryable ModelRetry rather than a hard failure; the agent is constructed with retries=5 (investigator.py 247).
